content:
sam: Nightdash alert — canary p95 latency +18% and throughput -12% starting ~02:00 UTC. Alert: https://dash.internal/nightdash/alert/842
perf-bot: Automatic perf CI flagged ~9% slowdown on kernel-selector scenario (seq_len=1024) in job PerfSuite/438
olivia: grafana shows the spike concentrated on canary-2..canary-5. GPU utilization up, but KV hit rate for those hosts fell from 0.92 -> 0.67 around the same time
mike: I think yesterday's runtime probe merge (PR #4123, commit abcdef7) increased prober sampling 20% -> 60% — could be churning KV cache and triggering different kernel paths
jena: confirmed in diff: `runtime/prober/config.go` changed `probeSampleRate = 0.6` (was 0.2). Also small change in kernel selector heuristics to prefer prober path for cold sequences
alex: kicking off local bench: `perf/bench --pool=canary --cases=kernel-selector --runs=3` — will post numbers in a few mins
sofia: CI logs point at kv-prefetch test regressions. Stack traces show more mutex contention in PrefetchRouter::route() after probe path goes hot
mike: triage plan: 1) revert probeSampleRate bump on canary 2) run isolated kernel-selector perf 3) bisect abcdef6..abcdef7 to isolate change set
sam: +1. This is a rollout blocker — please hold the 3.4.1 release until we validate
olivia: pinning rollout to stable and pinging @lucas (release manager) to hold the cut
lucas: ack, holding release. Also kicking perf-diff build: `buildkite perf-diff --base=abcdef6 --head=abcdef7`
alex: bench results so far: baseline p95=94ms -> canary p95=119ms; KV hit rate dropped 0.92 -> 0.68. Noticed increased short-lived allocations during prober: heap churn up ~35%
alex: profiling snippet:
```
flamegraph (hot paths):
runtime::select_kernel() heavy on new_prober path
kv::PrefetchRouter::route() shows increased mutex wait and syscall blocking
```
jena: that matches my repro — prober path touches more keys leading to opportunistic prefetches that evict hotset entries for long-seq requests
mike: opened revert PR #4130 (revert abcdef7). Please prioritize perf CI for that PR
ci-bot: Perf CI started: PerfSuite #439 (compare abcdef6..revert-abcdef7). Estimated completion ~20m
sam: if perf CI shows improvement we'll merge revert to canary, re-run Nightdash checks, then unpin rollout with a follow-up patch to make prober sampling opt-in and gated by KV pressure metrics
olivia: action items: mike -> revert PR and follow up with a smaller opt-in proposal; alex -> run perf-diff and attach flamegraphs; jena -> add guard to PrefetchRouter to avoid evicting protected hotset keys when prober is enabled
sofia: filing incident placeholder and will collect logs: incident/2026-03-18-nightdash-prefetch.json
sam: thanks everyone. Keep replies in-thread with short updates. :thumbsup:
